metadata.title: [BUG]: openCreateTeamModal undefined when clicking Create Team button
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Description
When clicking the 'Create Team' button in the admin UI, an error occurs: "undefined method for openCreateTeamModal".

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to the Teams tab in the admin UI
2. Click the 'Create Team' button
3. Observe error in browser console

## Expected Behavior
The Create Team modal should open when the button is clicked.

## Actual Behavior
JavaScript error: "undefined method for openCreateTeamModal"

## Technical Details
- Button element uses `data-action-click="openCreateTeamModal"` attribute
- Event delegation system requires functions to be accessible via `window.Admin` namespace
- Function is defined in inline script at line 14639 of `mcpgateway/templates/admin.html`

## Impact
- Severity: Medium
- Affects: Team creation functionality in admin UI
- User-facing: Yes

## Related Files
- `mcpgateway/templates/admin.html` (line 6106, 14639)
- `mcpgateway/admin_ui/eventDelegation.js`
